Class FirstAreaInPath

Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area)' if area of type AREA_TYPE is the first area in path of type PATH_TYPE.

Parameters:
  • nthArea - A positive number indicating the index (starting from 1) of area in path.
  • areaUserTypes - Types of areas that are counted. An argument of None will be interpreted as "no restriction", i.e. all user subtypes of base type AREA_TYPE are considered.
